description: This file defines the `GenericPasswordKeychainStore` enum, which provides static methods for securely storing, retrieving, and deleting string data in the iOS/macOS keychain using Security framework APIs.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the keychain for the given service and account.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string value into the keychain for the specified service and account, with an accessibility level.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the keychain item for the specified service and account.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Private method that loads raw Data from the keychain for the given service and account.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Private method that saves raw Data into the keychain, with rollback handling if the save fails.

methods.name: baseQuery
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary representing the keychain query parameters for the specified service and account.
